description: Job title: Junior Accountant (Hybrid, Lagos)

About the role: We are looking for a junior accountant to join our finance team in Lagos. You will process supplier invoices, reconcile bank accounts, support the month-end close, and prepare schedules for the finance manager.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Accounting or a related field
- Up to 2 years of accounting experience, including graduate or NYSC placements
- Working knowledge of Excel and at least one accounting package such as QuickBooks, Sage, or Zoho Books
- Strong attention to detail and a good record-keeping habit

Nice to have: experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.

We offer a supportive team, structured training, and a clear path to senior accounting roles. Send your application to the address below.
